title: The $λ>0$ case for $Δu=λ-c e^u$ type equation on high dimensional spheres
summary: Motivated by prescribed Chern scalar curvature problems in complex geometry, we study the equation $Δ_{\mathbb S^{N-1}}V+λ(e^V-1)=0$ with $λ>0$ on spheres. For $N\ge4$ and $λ>2(N-2)$ with $λ\ne2N$, we prove the existence of a nonconstant smooth solution that is axially symmetric and symmetric about the equator.
